title: rangeInput without Button
body:
Since it's not possible to have a custom search field for a certain facet, I'd like to use rangeInput to have a similar functionality. But the rangeInput features a submit button which I would like to get rid of.

So the user would enter a value and instantly search / filter that facet. I could not find anything regarding that in the v3 docs.

Is is possible to remove the button and use keyup instead? A better solution would be to have a second, single search field for a specific facet, but according to multiple SO entries, that is not possible.
